# Prompt reference

7 prompts. Ready-made agile workflows (`prompts/list`, `prompts/get`). A prompt is static text that tells
the model which tools to call and how to treat what they return (Agility text is untrusted data, the workflow is read-only);
it never calls Agility itself, so getting one costs no request (completing an argument does, see below). Arguments are strings, validated like tool arguments (plain text
on one line, bounded) and quoted into the text as values for the tools. A prompt whose tools are not all allowed for the
workspace or grant does not exist: it is not listed and getting it fails. The three that use report tools need the opt-in
`reports` group. The plan: [tool catalogue](tool-catalogue.md#prompts-phase-6).

## Argument completion

`completion/complete` suggests values (at most 20) for these arguments of an offered prompt, through the list tool named
here, so the workspace's projects, asset types, budget and output rules apply as for a call. It makes one call of that tool, so
it costs at most the tool's declared requests, and nothing when the tool is not allowed or the prompt is not offered. A
suggestion is dropped unless the prompt's argument rules accept it (plain text on one line).

| Argument | Tool | Cost (requests) | Also suggests |
|---|---|---|---|
| `team` | `list_teams` | 2 | - |
| `project` | `list_projects` | 5 | - |
| `sprint` | `list_sprints` | 10 | `current`, `previous`, `next` |

| Prompt | Purpose | Uses |
|---|---|---|
| `review_backlog_item_quality` | Assess one backlog item, a sprint or a team’s backlog against the versioned quality rubric and propose concrete improvements. | `work_item_quality`, `get_work_item`, `search_work_items` |
| `sprint_review` | Summarise a sprint for a review or demo: what finished, what did not, and what to show. | `get_sprint`, `search_work_items` |
| `standup` | Prepare a member’s or team’s daily stand-up notes: done since the last stand-up, in progress, and what needs attention. | `standup_summary` |
| `triage_defects` | Walk through open defects that need attention and propose priorities and owners for a person to confirm. | `defect_triage`, `get_work_item` |
| `draft_release_notes` | Draft release notes from the items completed in a sprint or under an epic. | `search_work_items`, `get_portfolio_tree` |
| `refine_backlog` | Suggest splits and acceptance criteria for the top of a backlog. Suggestions only. | `search_work_items`, `get_work_item` |
| `explain_asset` | Explain one asset in context: where it sits, what it contains, what changed and what was said. | `get_work_item`, `get_asset_history`, `get_conversations` |

## `review_backlog_item_quality`

Assess one backlog item, a sprint or a team’s backlog against the versioned quality rubric and propose concrete improvements.

Uses: [`work_item_quality`](tools.md#work_item_quality), [`get_work_item`](tools.md#get_work_item), [`search_work_items`](tools.md#search_work_items). Offered only when all of those tools are allowed for the workspace and grant.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `asset` | no | One item: number (B-01234) or OID token. |
| `sprint` | no | Sprint name, Timebox:<id>, or current, previous or next. |
| `team` | no | Team name or Team:<id>. |
| `project` | no | Agility project name or Scope:<id>. |

## `sprint_review`

Summarise a sprint for a review or demo: what finished, what did not, and what to show.

Uses: [`get_sprint`](tools.md#get_sprint), [`search_work_items`](tools.md#search_work_items). Offered only when all of those tools are allowed for the workspace and grant.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sprint` | no | Sprint name, Timebox:<id>, or current, previous or next. |
| `team` | no | Team name or Team:<id>. |
| `project` | no | Agility project name or Scope:<id>. |

## `standup`

Prepare a member’s or team’s daily stand-up notes: done since the last stand-up, in progress, and what needs attention.

Uses: [`standup_summary`](tools.md#standup_summary). Offered only when that tool is allowed for the workspace and grant.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `member` | no | The owner: me, a username, a name or Member:<id>. |
| `team` | no | Team name or Team:<id>. |
| `project` | no | Agility project name or Scope:<id>. |
| `time_range` | no | Window, for example "yesterday" or "last 2 days". |

## `triage_defects`

Walk through open defects that need attention and propose priorities and owners for a person to confirm.

Uses: [`defect_triage`](tools.md#defect_triage), [`get_work_item`](tools.md#get_work_item). Offered only when all of those tools are allowed for the workspace and grant.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | no | Agility project name or Scope:<id>. |
| `team` | no | Team name or Team:<id>. |
| `sprint` | no | Sprint name, Timebox:<id>, or current, previous or next. |

## `draft_release_notes`

Draft release notes from the items completed in a sprint or under an epic.

Uses: [`search_work_items`](tools.md#search_work_items), [`get_portfolio_tree`](tools.md#get_portfolio_tree). Offered only when all of those tools are allowed for the workspace and grant.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sprint` | no | Sprint name, Timebox:<id>, or current, previous or next. |
| `asset` | no | An epic: number (E-01234) or OID token. |
| `project` | no | Agility project name or Scope:<id>. |
| `team` | no | Team name or Team:<id>. |

## `refine_backlog`

Suggest splits and acceptance criteria for the top of a backlog. Suggestions only.

Uses: [`search_work_items`](tools.md#search_work_items), [`get_work_item`](tools.md#get_work_item). Offered only when all of those tools are allowed for the workspace and grant.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `team` | no | Team name or Team:<id>. |
| `project` | no | Agility project name or Scope:<id>. |
| `limit` | no | How many items to refine, from 1 to 20. |

## `explain_asset`

Explain one asset in context: where it sits, what it contains, what changed and what was said.

Uses: [`get_work_item`](tools.md#get_work_item), [`get_asset_history`](tools.md#get_asset_history), [`get_conversations`](tools.md#get_conversations). Offered only when all of those tools are allowed for the workspace and grant.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `asset` | yes | Number (B-01234, D-00012) or OID token. |
